subject: LAB-042
check: Desktop Native Power static accessibility, privacy, rights, and automation review
steps: Read the Mac views, session, Services provider, commands, intent, and bundled fixture.
Review the LAB-042 walkthrough and manual accessibility matrix.
Search DesktopNativePower and Apps/Mac/Desktop for Process, NSTask, posix_spawn, system, and executable paths.

outcome.detail: Review completed with open findings. Every declared gesture has a named menu command and shortcut in source. Intent accepts an enum with two commands; the implementation has no process execution API. Original fixture material only; no screenshot, video, user-document export, account, or real media retained. Private restoration excludes bodies and private IDs but is not encryption and does not hide titles. Native close lacks a station callback; repeated ordinary restore adds routes; menu-bar Open does not select the destination; file cancellation displays invalid text; asynchronous Services failures cannot reach the original error pointer; private row uses a middle dot and session results lack explicit announcements. The file handler reads all bytes in a detached task before text validation; no pre-read byte bound or in-flight read cancellation was demonstrated.

limitations: Static review only, with unresolved UI and accessibility findings; not a live or manual accessibility pass.
No VoiceOver, Voice Control, Full Keyboard Access, system Services delivery, Shortcuts/Siri, file dialog, or native document-window lifecycle qualification.
The qualification leaves the experiment implemented and does not establish release readiness.
